svg.title: Cross-block mask: paired task evidence
svg.desc: Mask off to mask on. Historical LLaDA OBS original30 and separate LLaDA and DiffusionGemma CPU pilots.
svg.text: Every pair reads mask OFF → ON. ON blocks earlier queries from reading later blocks; compare only within each panel.
Historical GPU runs / original30: 10 per dataset / fixed windows, not hard caps; no trigger split
CPU pilot3 / first original30 case per dataset / full requests; first intervention is numbered from 1
CPU pilot3 / separate executor / replay_open (OFF) → replay (ON); subsets partition All three
CPU pilot3 / offers 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 / replay_open (OFF) → replay (ON); exposure subsets partition the same three cases
CPU pilot3 / fixed offer, not equal work / q512_open (OFF) → q512 (ON); subsets partition All three
TPF = mean request N/F. Efficiency = total output tokens / total physical Q. No cross-panel average or official frozen90 GPU score.
A: llada21-obs30-mask-paired.csv B: gemma-mask-cpu-pilot3.json C: gemma-unified-mask-pilot3.csv
